verdict.rationale: Kong documents a provider-agnostic API that shields client applications from provider-specific APIs. It can also proxy requests from AI command-line tools to LLM providers, which implies clients can be redirected to the gateway. However, the evidence never states that the API is OpenAI-compatible or that existing OpenAI SDK code works by swapping only the base URL and key. Missing for 10: explicit OpenAI-compatible endpoint documentation, a drop-in base-URL/key swap guide or example, and independent or hands-on confirmation that unmodified OpenAI client code works.

support.subject: As a developer, I can point existing OpenAI-compatible code at the gateway by changing only the base URL and key

citations.quote: The core of AI Gateway is the ability to serve AI Models from various AI Model Providers via a provider-agnostic API.
Client applications are shielded from AI Provider API specifics, promoting code reusability
AI Gateway can proxy requests from AI command-line tools to LLM providers.
